description:
Cast Emptiness for its evoke cost by paying {W}{W}.
When Emptiness enters, its first ability and evoke ability trigger.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Emptiness, adding {W}.
Resolve Emptiness's evoke trigger, failing to sacrifice it as it's no longer on the battlefield.
Resolve Emptiness's first trigger, returning Cadaver Imp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cadaver Imp enters, it triggers, returning Emptiness from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cadaver Imp, adding {W}.
Repeat.
